links.outcome: Readability of LLM melanoma management responses (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade, Coleman-Liau)
links.effect: ChatGPT Flesch Reading Ease 35.42 (±21.02), Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 11.98 (±4.49), Coleman-Liau 12.00 (±5.10); mean readability scores were the same across the three LLMs (difficult, college-level text).
links.quote: ChatGPT exhibited superiority with a Flesch Reading Ease Score of 35.42 (±21.02), Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level of 11.98 (±4.49) and Coleman-Liau Index of 12.00 (±5.10), however all of these were insignificant (p > 0.05).

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the performance and readability of three commercial LLMs (BARD, BingAI, and ChatGPT-4) responding to melanoma management questions, assessed by expert clinicians, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
